headline: IRON RING enters the arcade
lede: A complete one-on-one fighter in the spirit of the 1991 arcade classic — original fighters, stages and moves — with a shared fighting engine under it that the next fighter will reuse. Low-poly 3D fighters on a 2D plane, SFIV camera, live crowds, and head-to-head over room codes.

notes.text: #1095 shipped via #1098: 6-fighter arcade ladder (easy→insane), best-of-3, motion-input specials, EX at half meter and automatic supers at full, throws, chains and crouch-blocking.
The fighting core lives in src/engine/fighting.js — seeded and deterministic, so online fights are identical on both boxes (hash-checked every 30 ticks) and #1096 can drop its roster straight in.
QA #1103 filed: multi-hit supers, guard crush, KO slow-mo and stage midground variety are the polish round.
ironringcheck: 33 gates (rules, determinism, every CPU tier completes a match) plus a proven-fail mutant — a dead hitbox gate turns the suite red.

look.text: MYST: MYST stage 3 — CHANNELWOOD walkable (channels + star terrace)
SSX: SSX browser-drive harness (ssxplay) — real keys drive a real heat
